title: Energy Density Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the energy density of photons as U/V = A T^4.

title: Radiant Flux Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the flux of radiant energy as J_U = B T^4.

title: Temperature Proportionality
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the relationship T_e = T_s sqrt(R_s / 2 R_es) correctly.

title: Temperature Change Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the change in temperature due to the solar screen.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the equations.

title: Final Answer Presentation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must present final answers clearly and correctly.
